title: Senior Odoo Technical Consultant
description:
🚀
 **We're Hiring: Senior Odoo Technical Consultant** 




 📍 Infopark Thrissur, Koratty \| 🕒 Full\-Time \| 💼 5\+ Years Experience
 



 Are you an Odoo expert who enjoys designing solutions, not just building them? We're looking for a
 **Senior Odoo Technical Consultant** 
 to lead the design, development, integration and deployment of enterprise\-grade Odoo ERP solutions, and to guide a growing development team.
 



**What you'll do** 




 🔹 Design scalable, secure and upgrade\-friendly Odoo solutions
 



 🔹 Develop and customise modules, workflows, reports and dashboards
 



 🔹 Build REST API integrations with HRMS, Payroll, CRM, banking, payment gateway and e\-commerce platforms
 



 🔹 Lead technical workstreams, run code reviews and mentor junior developers
 



 🔹 Manage deployments, version upgrades, migrations and performance tuning
 



 🔹 Take part in client workshops and technical discussions
 



**What we're looking for** 




 ✅ 5\+ years of hands\-on Odoo development and technical consulting
 



 ✅ Multiple end\-to\-end Odoo implementations
 



 ✅ Advanced Python and strong PostgreSQL skills
 



 ✅ Deep knowledge of the Odoo framework, ORM, security, automated actions and scheduled jobs
 



 ✅ Experience with REST APIs, JSON/XML and Git
 



 ✅ Working knowledge of Linux, plus exposure to Azure, AWS or Docker
 



 ✅ Bachelor's degree in CS, IT, Software Engineering, Computer Applications or a related field
 



**Nice to have** 




 ⭐ Odoo Technical Certification
 



 ⭐ Experience with Odoo 16, 17 or newer
 



 ⭐ Kubernetes, CI/CD and DevOps practices
 



 ⭐ Multi\-company or multi\-country Odoo environments
 



 If you're ready to own the technical side of ERP implementations, we'd like to hear from you.
 



 Know someone who fits? Tag them or share this post! 🙌

title: Senior Software Test Engineer

title: Backend Engineer – Ruby on Rails (AWS / PostgreSQL)
company: Cascade Revenue Management - An AIMA Group Company
description:
**Role Overview** 




 We are seeking a talented and motivated Ruby on Rails Developer with strong expertise in cloud infrastructure (AWS) and relational databases (PostgreSQL). In this role, you will be responsible for
 



 designing, building, and maintaining scalable server\-side web applications. You will collaborate closely with cross\-functional teams, including front\-end developers, product managers, and designers, to deliver high\-quality, secure, and performant solutions.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





 ●  
 **Application Development:** 
 Design, build, and maintain efficient, reusable, and reliable Ruby
 



 code using the Rails framework.
 



  





 ●  
 **Database Architecture:** 
 Design and optimize relational databases using PostgreSQL, including
 



 writing complex queries, managing migrations, and ensuring data integrity and
 



 overall system performance.
 



  





 ●  
 **Cloud Infrastructure:** 
 Deploy, monitor, and scale applications utilizing Amazon Web Services
 



 (AWS). Manage and configure core services such as EC2, S3, RDS, and Elastic
 



 Beanstalk.
 



  





 ●  
 **API Design:** 
 Develop and maintain RESTful (or GraphQL) APIs to seamlessly support
 



 front\-end integrations and third\-party services.
 



  





 ●  
 **Code Quality \& Testing:** 
 Write comprehensive automated test suites using tools like RSpec or
 



 Capybara. Conduct peer code reviews to maintain code quality, organization, and
 



 automation.
 



  





 ●  
 **Performance Optimization:** 
 Identify bottlenecks and bugs, devising solutions to mitigate these
 



 issues and ensure application scalability for high\-traffic environments.
 



  





 ●  
 **Collaboration:** 
 Work in an Agile environment, actively participating in daily
 



 stand\-ups, sprint planning, and retrospectives.
 



  





**Required Qualifications** 




  





 ●  
 **Experience:** 
 5\+ years of professional software development experience, with a
 



 proven track record in building web applications in a production environment.
 



  





 ●  
 **Ruby on Rails:** 
 Expert\-level understanding of Ruby syntax, object\-oriented
 



 programming, and the Rails framework (MVC architecture, ActiveRecord,
 



 ActiveJob).
 



  





 ●  
 **Database Management:** 
 Strong proficiency with
 **PostgreSQL** 
 , including database design,
 



 indexing, query optimization, and troubleshooting.
 



  





 ●  
 **Cloud Computing:** 
 Hands\-on experience with the
 **AWS** 
 ecosystem and deployment
 



 pipelines. Familiarity with managing cloud environments and ensuring robust
 



 system security.
 



  





 ●  
 **Version Control:** 
 Proficiency with Git and GitHub/GitLab in a collaborative, team\-based
 



 setting.
 



  





 ●  
 **Problem\-Solving:** 
 Excellent analytical skills with a proactive approach to tackling
 



 complex technical challenges.
 



  





 ●  
 **Communication:** 
 Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to
 



 clearly explain technical concepts to non\-technical stakeholders.
 



  





  





**Preferred Qualifications (Nice to Have)** 




  





 ●  Experience with modern front\-end technologies (e.g., JavaScript, React, Vue.js, HTML5, CSS3\).
 



  





 ●  Familiarity with background job processing and queuing systems (e.g., Sidekiq, Redis).
 



  





 ●  Knowledge of containerization and orchestration tools (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes).
 



  





 ●  Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines (e.g., GitHub Actions, CircleCI, AWS CodePipeline)

title: Backend Developer
description:
We are looking for a Backend Developer with 2\+ years of hands\-on experience in Node.js and Python to join our engineering team. You will build and maintain server\-side applications, RESTful APIs, database systems, and business logic. You will work closely with frontend developers, product managers, and DevOps teams to deliver secure, scalable, and reliable applications.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Design, develop, and maintain RESTful or GraphQL APIs using Node.js and Python.
* Build server\-side logic and application workflows.
* Develop backend services using Node.js frameworks and Python frameworks such as FastAPI, Django, or Flask.
* Design clean database schemas and write optimized queries.
* Work with relational and NoSQL databases.
* Develop secure authentication and authorization systems using JWT, OAuth, or similar methods.
* Connect third\-party services such as payment gateways, cloud storage, and messaging platforms.
* Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks.
* Implement caching solutions such as Redis when required.
* Write clean, maintainable, and well\-tested code.
* Conduct and participate in code reviews.
* Troubleshoot bugs and production issues.
* Work with frontend developers, product managers, and DevOps teams.
* Participate in Agile/Scrum meetings, requirement discussions, and effort estimation.



  





**Required Skills** 



* 2\+ years of professional experience in backend development with Node.js and/or Python.
* Strong knowledge of modern JavaScript and ES6\+.
* Good knowledge of Python programming and backend development.
* Good understanding of asynchronous programming, Promises, Async/Await, and the Node.js Event Loop.
* Hands\-on experience with Express.js, NestJS, FastAPI, Django, Flask, or similar frameworks.
* Strong understanding of RESTful API development.
* Experience with middleware, error handling, authentication, and API security.
* Experience with PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, or similar databases.
* Knowledge of database schema design and query optimization.
* Experience with ORM/ODM tools such as Prisma, TypeORM, Mongoose, Sequelize, SQLAlchemy, or Django ORM.
* Knowledge of Git and version control workflows.
* Familiarity with API testing tools such as Postman or Insomnia.
* Basic understanding of Docker and Linux.
* Familiarity with CI/CD and deployment processes.
* TypeScript experience is preferred.



  





**Tools and Technologies** 



* Node.js
* Python
* Express.js / NestJS
* FastAPI / Django / Flask
* JavaScript / TypeScript
* PostgreSQL / MySQL / MongoDB
* Prisma / TypeORM / Mongoose / Sequelize
* SQLAlchemy / Django ORM
* REST API / GraphQL
* Redis
* JWT / OAuth
* Git / GitHub
* Postman / Insomnia
* Docker
* Linux
* Jest / Mocha / Pytest
* CI/CD pipelines



  





**Qualifications** 



* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.
* 2\+ years of professional backend development experience.
* Experience working on production\-grade Node.js and/or Python applications.
* Strong problem\-solving and debugging skills.
* Good understanding of software development practices.
* Ability to work independently as well as with a development team.



  





**What We Expect** 



* Write clean, structured, and maintainable code.
* Take ownership of assigned backend features and tasks.
* Understand requirements and convert them into practical technical solutions.
* Follow coding standards and development best practices.
* Test your work before delivery.
* Communicate clearly with team members and stakeholders.
* Be willing to learn new technologies and improve your technical skills.
* Take responsibility for resolving issues and delivering tasks within agreed timelines.



  





**Location Requirement** 



* Kerala\-based candidates only
